HISTORICAL UNIT - no longer exists. Abolished 2 Jan 2019 and split into Chugach Census Area (02063) and Copper River Census Area (02066). Any Alaska license or permit printed before Jan 2019 that names this area carries THIS name, not Chugach or Copper River.

HISTORICAL UNIT - renamed. Renamed Kusilvak Census Area effective 1 July 2015 and reassigned FIPS 02158; this row carries the original code 02270. Artifacts predating July 2015 read Wade Hampton. Note: some third-party FIPS datasets wrongly file Wade Hampton under 02158.
HISTORICAL UNIT - no longer exists. Split 1 June 2008 into Wrangell City and Borough (02275) and Petersburg Census Area (02195). Artifacts predating June 2008 read Wrangell-Petersburg.

HISTORICAL UNIT - no longer exists. Dissolved in 2008: Outer Ketchikan was annexed by Ketchikan Gateway Borough (19 May 2008), part went to the new Wrangell City and Borough (1 June 2008), and the remainder was renamed Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area (02198).
HISTORICAL UNIT - no longer exists. Split 20 June 2007 into Skagway Municipality (02230) and Hoonah-Angoon Census Area (02105). Artifacts predating June 2007 read Skagway-Hoonah-Angoon.

HISTORICAL UNIT - renamed. Renamed Oglala Lakota County effective 1 May 2015 and reassigned FIPS 46102; this row carries the original code 46113. South Dakota licenses printed before May 2015 read Shannon, so this is the name that appears on essentially every collectible SD item from this county. Note: some third-party FIPS datasets wrongly file Shannon under 46102.

HISTORICAL UNIT - no longer exists. Independent city until 1 July 2001, when it merged with Alleghany County (51005) and reverted to town status. Virginia issued county and independent-city licenses, so pre-2001 VA licenses can name Clifton Forge as its own jurisdiction. Added on the same logic as the existing Bedford City row (independent city until it merged into Bedford County in 2013).

HISTORICAL UNIT - abolished. One of Virginia's eight original 1634 shires; merged into the city of Hampton in 1952. VA licences from 1916-1952 can name Elizabeth City County. No FIPS code: FIPS 6-4 was not established until 1970, so jurisdictions that ceased before then never received one. Blank is correct, not missing.

HISTORICAL UNIT - abolished. Warwick County until 1952, then the independent city of Warwick, consolidated into Newport News in 1958. Licences from 1916-1952 name the county and 1952-1958 the city. No FIPS code: FIPS 6-4 was not established until 1970, so jurisdictions that ceased before then never received one. Blank is correct, not missing.

HISTORICAL UNIT - abolished. Created 1691 from Lower Norfolk; merged with the city of South Norfolk in 1963 to form the city of Chesapeake. Named with the County suffix because the independent city of Norfolk (51710) still exists and is a separate jurisdiction. No FIPS code: FIPS 6-4 was not established until 1970, so jurisdictions that ceased before then never received one. Blank is correct, not missing.

HISTORICAL UNIT - abolished. Created 1691 from Lower Norfolk; merged into the city of Virginia Beach on 1 Jan 1963. VA licences from 1916-1963 can name Princess Anne County. No FIPS code: FIPS 6-4 was not established until 1970, so jurisdictions that ceased before then never received one. Blank is correct, not missing.

HISTORICAL UNIT - abolished. Independent city 1919-1963, then combined with Norfolk County to form the city of Chesapeake. No FIPS code: FIPS 6-4 was not established until 1970, so jurisdictions that ceased before then never received one. Blank is correct, not missing.
